some of the hardest trades to execute are the ones you planned weeks in advance

it's easy to look at a chart and identify levels where you'd want to buy, but when price actually gets there after days of selling, your conviction gets tested

that's why i like setting alerts and marking important levels before the market reaches them

$ZEC around $750 is one area i'm watching. it's a significant historical level, although getting there would likely require a much deeper market correction

doing the work beforehand helps me stay prepared when volatility picks up
